# VLC 3.0 modules linked into CyanBridge's trimmed libvlc.so (one per line).
# Every other module that VLC builds is left out of the static module table.
#
# What the app plays (see README.md):
#  - glasses live preview: RTSP over TCP (rtsp-tcp) from the in-app relay,
#    H.264 (H.265 tolerated) video, AAC / G.711 / PCM audio, decoded with
#    :codec=avcodec;
#  - Mentra Live: in-app RTMP ingest remuxed to MPEG-TS, served at
#    http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<token>.ts;
#  - output to VLCVideoLayout (inline preview) or to an ImageReader surface
#    (Walking Aid frames).

# Access and network
live555                 # RTSP client (demux + access), needs the live555 contrib
http                    # http:// access (Mentra loopback MPEG-TS)
https                   # HTTP/1.1 + HTTP/2 access; also takes plain http://
filesystem              # file:// and fd:// (diagnostics, local fixtures)

# Stream filters
prefetch
cache_read
cache_block

# Demuxers
ts                      # MPEG-TS (Mentra), needs libdvbpsi
es                      # raw audio elementary streams (ADTS AAC, MPEG audio)
h26x                    # raw H.264 / H.265 elementary streams
mp4                     # MP4 files: CI's Walking Aid model test plays its fixture as file://

# Packetizers
packetizer_h264
packetizer_hevc
packetizer_mpeg4audio   # AAC (ADTS, LATM, raw)
packetizer_mpegaudio
packetizer_copy

# Decoders
avcodec                 # libavcodec: h264, hevc, aac, aac_latm, mp2/mp3, opus, mjpeg, g726
araw                    # PCM / L16 / L8
g711                    # A-law / mu-law

# Video output
android_window          # AWindow (VLCVideoLayout / setVideoSurface)
android_display         # ANativeWindow display, fallback when GLES2 is not usable
gles2                   # OpenGL ES 2 display (default on Android)
egl_android             # EGL for gles2
i420_rgb                # software I420 -> RV16/RV32 for android_display
i420_nv12
chroma_yuv_neon         # NEON converters: built for armeabi-v7a only
yuv_rgb_neon            # armeabi-v7a only

# Audio output and conversion
opensles_android
android_audiotrack
audio_format
float_mixer
integer_mixer
volume_neon             # armeabi-v7a only
trivial_channel_mixer
simple_channel_mixer
remap
ugly_resampler
scaletempo

# Misc
android_logger          # verbose LibVLC logs to logcat
memory_keystore         # LibVLC opens a keystore at start (warns without one)
